lines.text: You vibe-coded your app in a weekend. Nice. But is it secure?
Paste your URL. We scan it the way attackers do.
Gemma 4 reads the results, and tells you in plain English what to fix first.
Open admin ports. Leaked usernames. Email anyone can spoof. Every risk comes with the fix.
Then you get your own security briefing video, ready to send to your co-founder or investors.
Your security grade, and the risks an attacker would try first.
Every public door into your app, mapped.
You shipped fast. Now ship secure.
Hit Fix my vibe, and we'll help you close every door.
